thread.title: Apple’s Rumored 6.5-Inch Supersized iPhone X Plus Is a Thing

author: Jon Swartz
title: Apple’s Rumored 6.5-Inch Supersized iPhone X Plus Is a Thing
text:
Super-size me isn't just for McDonald's (MCD).
Illustration: Getty Images Evidently that's what Apple (ticker: AAPL) has in mind with its rumored new iPhone X Plus, which would come with a 6.5-inch display.
MacRumors came up with photos from a "trial run of production equipment" depicting construction of the gigantic follow-up to the iPhone X, which debuted in late 2017.
KGI Securities Ming-Chi Kuo has speculated on such a device, which would dwarf the size of rival phones.
Apple rumors abound, but this one seems to have details and/or evidence to back it up. The flex cable and the part numbers shown in the photos align with current formats "typically used by Apple," MacRumors reports. It also noted, "The rear design of the part is also very similar but not identical to the iPhone X display assembly."
No timetable was given for the release date of the new super-sized phone, but Apple usually unveils its new iPhones in September. This has led to another rumor: iPhone X Plus and a lower-cost alternative, the 6.1-inch iPhone X SE, could debut by the end of 2018.
The new phones, if they do materialize, could help Apple grab an even larger share of the smartphone share. At the end of 2017, Apple controlled more than 50% of the smartphone market for the first time .
Shares of Apple have gained 2% to $178.96 at 11:41 a.m. today.
